summary: Implemented JSON pretty printing in the rich repository. Changes: new rich/json.py with the JSON renderable (parse, re-serialize with indent, highlight or null highlighter, no_wrap=True, overflow=None) and a __main__ CLI guarded by the main check; JSONHighlighter added to rich/highlighter.py after ReprHighlighter; six json.* entries in rich/default_styles.py; Console.print_json placed after print in rich/console.py; package-level print_json after print in rich/__init__.py (__all__ unchanged); "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst before "Low level output"; new docs/source/reference/json.rst added to docs/source/reference.rst toctree; CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added entry; new tests/test_json.py with a truecolor console test and a package-level test (existing tests untouched). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so the new tests are unverified. The expected ANSI string in the console test was derived by hand and is the first thing to check if it fails. Interpretation: the spec's "overflow to none" was implemented as Python None because Rich has no "none" overflow value.
